---
name: Feature request or model question
about: Suggest a change, or raise a point where the model is unclear
title: "[proposal] "
labels: enhancement
---

## What and why

What you would like the reference to express, and why it improves faithfulness to
the model or clarity for a reader.

## Relationship to the specification

Which part of the companion paper this concerns (for example "companion A.3
capability binding"). If the papers are silent here, say so - the preference is
to discuss rather than invent.

## Constraints check

Please confirm the proposal respects the project's non-negotiable constraints
(see CONTRIBUTING.md):

- [ ] Standard library only; deterministic; SHA-256.
- [ ] Does not imply tamper-evidence establishes completeness, causation or truth.
- [ ] Any model aid produces leads, not edges.
- [ ] No overclaiming (no fabricated benchmarks, accuracy figures or acceptance).

## Notes

Out-of-scope areas (live telemetry, operative preservation, anomaly scoring,
GUI/service/scale work) are welcome as discussion but will not be added to the
reference itself.
